items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Frank said to him, “Why did you pick up that ham?”

ctx.x: No, it was just, he [laughter], I don’t know. Frank said to him, “Why did you pick up that ham?” He says, “Because I like ham with my breakfast.” [laughter]
Well, with that size of a band, how were you getting to your gigs? Were you traveling around in a, like would you get a big station wagon and drive?
